title: Fix the 2R piece's destination logic and the evaluation's quick wins
description: Per explainers/_process/series/01-evaluation.md 'Immediate fixes': (1) destination logic — Maren's comment is about place, but it lands on 'small dense groups' and the figure strikes that condition's link to the goal, implying she disputes small groups. Make the text and figure agree: either her claim is a missing sub-condition ('rooted in an actual place') under that condition — draw it as a new box hanging under it, not a struck link — or her disagreement is with a specific link she actually argues against. Redraw destination as a standalone SVG. (2) Open with Maren, move the movement description after the story. (3) Cut the five-sheets figure and the lineage paragraph (lineage moves to the LTP-basics series). (4) Soften 'she has changed what the movement believes'. (5) Define 'reason commons' on first use or drop the phrase. Preview, push.
acceptance_criteria: Figure and text agree; the five fixes made; live.
close_reason: Destination redrawn (destination-v2.svg) as a missing condition; opens on Maren; five-sheets + lineage cut; overclaim softened; reason commons defined. Preview + phone check clean; pushed live.

title: Decompose the approved arc into per-chapter beads
description: Read the approved arc (and any comments on the gate issue: bd comments <gate-id>). For each chapter create two beads under the epic with label explainers-v2: 'Script: <nn> <title>' (draft → independent critique → revise against voice guide; files in explainers/_process/series/<nn>-<slug>/; stage discipline: no visual direction in the script) and 'Build: <nn> <title>' depending on its script bead and on the chapter-form bead (follow skills/illustrated-chapters/SKILL.md). Scripts can proceed in parallel; order builds by chapter number. Also add each build bead as a blocker of the 'Retire the long pieces' bead.
acceptance_criteria: One script and one build bead per chapter, deps wired, retire bead blocked on all builds.

title: Draft the arc of the illustrated introduction
description: Write explainers/_process/series/02-arc.md. Answer: who is the reader; what they should be able to say after the series; the chapter list, each with its one-sentence teaser (Co-Star style) and the one or two points it makes; the running example(s); how closely it follows the book (library/logical-thinking-process-dettmer/, Dettmer's chapter order: goal/system/constraint → CLR → IO map → CRT → evaporating cloud → FRT → PRT/TT) and Goldratt; what is kept, reshaped or dropped from the current pieces (explainers/_process/*/article.md, 01-bottleneck-plain, second-renaissance-plain); how the Second Renaissance series relates (its own short series, or the worked case). Order of chapters matters more than detail. Use the evaluation note. Rufus's framing: 'what is the arc, what is the story we're telling, and how' — work out the story first, form second.
acceptance_criteria: Arc doc committed with reader, takeaways, ordered chapter list with teasers, book mapping, keep/drop list.
close_reason: Arc draft at explainers/_process/series/02-arc.md: two cross-linked series (A: Thinking in trees, 10 chapters following Dettmer; B: Where does the thinking go?, 6 chapters), keep/drop table, five open questions.

title: Independent critique of the arc, then revise
description: Dispatch an independent subagent critique (fresh context, adversarial, as done for earlier scripts in explainers/_process/*/0*-critique*.md) of 02-arc.md: is the story right, is each chapter really one or two points, does the order build, is anything missing from the book's logic, is it too long. Save as 03-arc-critique.md, revise to 04-arc-v2.md. Then summarise the arc and the open questions for Rufus in the gate issue's notes and send a push notification if available.
acceptance_criteria: Critique and v2 committed; gate issue has a summary for Rufus.
close_reason: Critique saved as 03-arc-critique.md; revised to 04-arc-v2.md (8+5 chapters, B first, open question through A, arrow chapter, worked Demo C example). Gate notes written.

acceptance_criteria: Evaluation note committed, with recommendations the arc and form issues can act on.
close_reason: Evaluation at explainers/_process/series/01-evaluation.md (own read + independent cold read). Follow-ups filed: reasoncommons-bnl.12 (piece fixes), reasoncommons-bnl.13 (phone clipping #20, blocks retirement).

description: Design the chapter form per explainers/_process/series/costar-teardown.md. Markdown pages on Flowershow; static text column; SVG illustrations (inline or ), at least one looping animated SVG (SMIL/CSS, not JS, not scroll-driven) as proof; end-of-chapter next-chapter card + all-chapters list; series index as numbered one-line teasers. Mind AGENTS.md: no blank lines inside raw HTML in markdown.
